mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MBER_ROLE ( MBER_NO, ROLE_ID, ALWNC_DT, ALWNC_MBER_NO, END_DT, CREAT_MBER_NO, CREAT_DT, CHANGE_MBER_NO, CHANGE_DT ) VALUES ( #{mberNo}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{alwncMberNo}, #{endDt}, #{creatMberNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{changeMberNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT MBER_NO , ROLE_ID , ALWNC_DT , ALWNC_MBER_NO , END_DT , CREAT_MBER_NO , CREAT_DT , CHANGE_MBER_NO , CHANGE_DT FROM MBER_ROLE WHERE MBER_NO = #{mberNo} AND end_dt = to_timestamp('99991231235959', 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

select group_id , group_nm , group_dc , menu_id , menu_nm , menu_dc , menu_url , icon_nm , icon_color , inqire_posbl_at , regist_posbl_at , change_posbl_at , delete_posbl_at from (select c.group_id , c.group_nm , c.group_dc , c.sn , b.menu_id , b.menu_ordr , b.menu_nm , b.menu_dc , b.menu_url , b.icon_nm , b.icon_color , a.inqire_posbl_at , a.regist_posbl_at , a.change_posbl_at , a.delete_posbl_at from role_menu_author a , menu b , menu_group c where 'R0006' = #{roleId} and a.role_id = #{roleId} and a.use_at = 'Y' and a.menu_id = b.menu_id and b.use_at = 'Y'
and (b.menu_nm like '%' || #{nm} || '%' or b.menu_dc like '%' || #{nm} || '%')
and b.group_id = c.group_id and c.use_at = 'Y' union select d.group_id , d.group_nm , d.group_dc , d.sn , c.menu_id , c.menu_ordr , c.menu_nm , c.menu_dc , c.menu_url , c.icon_nm , c.icon_color , b.inqire_posbl_at , b.regist_posbl_at , b.change_posbl_at , b.delete_posbl_at from mber_role a , role_menu_author b , menu c , menu_group d where 'R0006' != #{roleId} and a.end_dt = to_timestamp('99991231235959', 'yyyymmddhh24miss') and a.mber_no = #{mberNo} and a.role_id = b.role_id and b.use_at = 'Y' and b.menu_id = c.menu_id and c.use_at = 'Y'
and (c.menu_nm like '%' || #{nm} || '%' or c.menu_dc like '%' || #{nm} || '%')
and c.group_id = d.group_id and d.use_at = 'Y') order by sn asc, menu_ordr asc
